title: The Kabbalah Unveiled
author: S. L. MacGregor Mathers (trans)
description: S. L. MacGregor Mathers presents translations and commentary introducing Kabbalistic material to an English-speaking esoteric readership. The work is influential in Western occultism and reflects the interpretive setting of that transmission.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/b24884443).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
